name: canopy-tree
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One complete stylized tropical CANOPY TREE for a polished adventure platformer game. Distinct from a palm: a broad low umbrella crown supported by an elegant slightly bent cinnamon-brown trunk splitting into four substantial branches, with broad flared buttress roots. Foliage is arranged in five overlapping flattened canopies with sculpted scalloped edges and a few large readable leaf-tip shapes. NO tiny individual leaves, no realistic leaf texture, no spherical lollipop crown, no hundreds of branches. Simple sophisticated geometry, large clean color planes: warm brown bark with just a few wide flowing grooves, deep forest-green undersides, jade green middle planes, warm lime-green upper planes. About 14m tall, 15m crown width, trunk about 1.3m thick. The crown has a strong arched umbrella silhouette and generous volume, creating a ceiling over a jungle trail. Modern stylized game art, restrained detail, rounded bevels, expressive curves. Isolated entire tree on neutral light grey, no ground, no pedestal, no other objects, no text or watermark. Three-quarter orthographic view with full crown and roots visible and ample margin.
